skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target. After using the Ultimate for the first time, Normal Attacks can reduce the duration of [Non-Crit Undying].

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: When attacking, reduces the target’s [Non-Crit Undying] duration by 1 turn. Deals 7000% ATK [Specialized Direct DMG] to a single enemy (only affected by advanced DMG modifiers). Ignores 45% [Specialized Dodge] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], and pierces [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding].

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: When attacking, reduces the target’s [Non-Crit Undying] duration by 1 turn. Deals 10000% ATK [Specialized Direct DMG] to a single enemy (only affected by advanced DMG modifiers). Ignores 45% [Specialized Dodge] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], and pierces [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding]. Increases own CRIT Rate by 50%.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 60% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. Whenever any character is defeated, gains 1 stack of [Rage], up to 2 stacks. Each stack of [Rage] allows the Ultimate to target 1 additional enemy.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 70% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. Whenever any character is defeated, gains 1 stack of [Rage], up to 2 stacks. Each stack of [Rage] allows the Ultimate to target 1 additional enemy.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: At battle start, gains 80% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. Whenever any character is defeated, gains 1 stack of [Rage], up to 3 stacks. Each stack of [Rage] allows the Ultimate to target 1 additional enemy.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: When about to be defeated, enters the [Rebirth] state, absorbing all incoming DMG during that time. On the next turn, restores 50% HP and gains [Energy Shield] equal to the total amount of absorbed DMG. Can trigger up to 3 times. At battle start, gains 30% [Suppression Guard]. [Suppression Guard]: Reduces DMG taken by 30%. If own Attack is higher than the attacker’s, the DMG reduction is increased to 1.5×.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: When about to be defeated, enters the [Rebirth] state, absorbing all incoming DMG during that time. On the next turn, restores 100% HP and gains [Energy Shield] equal to the total amount of absorbed DMG. Can trigger up to 5 times. At battle start, gains 40% [Suppression Guard]. [Suppression Guard]: Reduces DMG taken by 40%. If own Attack is higher than the attacker’s, the DMG reduction is increased to 1.7×.

effects.desc: Đòn chí mạng gây thêm sát thương; Some units may be immune to [Crit].
The revive/return mechanism is tied to the life of the ally, bringing the unit back into the match.
The shield type converts its cumulative value into damage reduction, is limited to a multiple of the unit's maximum Health, and cannot be used with Resurrection.
The defensive effect reduces damage taken (30–40%), increasing to a 150–170% reduction when the bearer's ST is higher than the attacker's.
